en: A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life.
zh: 敢浪费一小时的人，还没有发现生命的价值。
line: A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life. — Charles Darwin

word.ex: The ship was on the point of arriving at her destination.
word.exzh: 这艘船即将到达她的目的地
